### Development tools / Embedded

*   Development Tools
    *   [matheuswhite/scope-rs (⭐36)](https://github.com/matheuswhite/scope-rs) \[[scope-monitor](https://crates.io/crates/scope-monitor)] - Cross-platform serial-port & RTT monitor TUI with hex/@tag input macros, search, session recording, and Lua plugins.     *   [Vaishnav-Sabari-Girish/ComChan (⭐160)](https://github.com/Vaishnav-Sabari-Girish/ComChan) - A minimal serial monitor with plotter TUI.
